name: tuios
title: Tuios
description: See every tuios agent, jump to it in Ghostty, WezTerm or any terminal, answer its prompts, message it, start new ones and move panes between sessions.
author: devansh

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Agents
commands.subtitle: tuios
commands.description: Every agent in every tuios session: jump, approve, deny, message, move.

commands.name: jump-waiting
commands.title: Jump to Agent Needing Me
commands.subtitle: tuios
commands.description: Focus the agent that has waited longest and bring its terminal forward.

commands.name: start-agent
commands.title: Start Agent
commands.subtitle: tuios
commands.description: Start Claude, Codex or any agent CLI in a project, in the tuios session you pick.

preferences.name: defaultAgent
preferences.title: Default Agent
preferences.description: The agent command Start Agent uses, as you would type it.

preferences.name: projectRoots
preferences.title: Project Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folders whose git repos Start Agent offers.

preferences.name: fallbackTerminal
preferences.title: Terminal for Detached Sessions
preferences.description: Opened (running tuios attach) when a session is not showing in any terminal.

preferences.name: tuiosPath
preferences.title: tuios Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to find it in Homebrew, ~/.local/bin or ~/go/bin.
